viloxazine.quote: Ki Values of 630, 3900 and 6400 nM for NET, 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C, Respectively
viloxazine.note: The Table 3 title is taken: the paper's Results prose lists the two values in the other order (3900 nM at 5-HT2C, 6400 nM at 5-HT2B), but Table 3's own occupancies (5-HT2B always above 5-HT2C at the same concentration) need the lower Ki at 5-HT2B. The paper does not say how or in which species the Ki values were obtained.

norketamine.quote: The Ki values of ketamine, norketamine and dehydronorketamine at NMDA receptors were 0.119±0.01, 0.97±0.1 and 3.21±0.3 μM, respectively.
norketamine.note: [3H]MK-801 binding; the abstract names no enantiomer, so it is read as the unqualified (racemic) norketamine.
